Notes: Clan Equipment Vendor (CNTD), ICC Shuttleport (4582) at (918.7, 47.4, 864.5). Rebuilt from 4 QuestDialogCapture dumps (Clan_Equipment_Vendor_CNTD, 2026-10-20, character Complicado, a Clan member). Only Clan-side dialog was captured. {shop} is placed where he points at the shopping basket for 'New equipment'.

new_equipment.Text: New equipment, you say? Let's see what you've got for sale.

got_armor.Text: I've got some Newcomer's Armor. How do I upgrade it?

no_armor.Text: I don't have any Newcomer's Armor yet.

appreciate.Text: Appreciate the help, thanks a lot.

sounds_great.Text: Sounds great! I'll be back a little bit later.

Text: {delay 1}\nI see you're one of us now...
{delay 1}\nBeing a member of the Clans is something to be proud of--knowing you are fighting every day for justice and freedom on this beautiful dusty-red planet, Rubi-Ka.
{delay 3}\nAnd I even have armor upgrades and new equipment which can help you in your cause!
It's great armor, only wearable by freedom fighting Clans!
{delay 3}\nAll you need is some Newcomer's Armor to upgrade.
{delay 2}\n{emote}Click on the shopping basket to open the shop window.{/emote}
{delay 5}\nLook for the Joint Clans Badge in the shop inventory.
{delay 4}\nYou'll want to buy one Joint Clans Badge for each piece of Newcomer's Armor you want to upgrade.
{delay 3}\nTo upgrade, first make sure you're not wearing your armor, then attach a Joint Clans Badge to an armor piece.
{delay 5}\nThis will start a chemical reaction which will change the molecular structure of the armor - it will become Joint Clans Newcomer's Armor.

absolutely.Text: Absolutely! I'm always happy to help a fellow Clansperson!

Text: Go have a chat with the Equipment Vendor over by the control tower.
{delay 1} He sells Newcomer's Armor which I can help you upgrade.

wonderful.Text: Wonderful! Looking forward to chatting with you again.

Text: Of course! I think you'll find some things you can use
{delay 3}{shop}\n{emote}Click on the shopping basket to open the shop window.{/emote}
